name: Vampyres

unlocks.name: Actual Vampyre Slayer
unlocks.notes: Allows Chaeldar, Konar, Nieve/Steve, and Duradel/Kuradal to assign Vampyres.

requiredItemName: Blisterwood flail or Ivandis flail for Vyrewatch

variantInfo.name: Feral Vampyre
notes: Combat levels are 61, 64, 70, 72, 77, 100, and 130; Slayer XP values are 40, 80, 75, 50, 60, 135, and 185.
Can be killed with any weaponry and always drops vampyre dust.
Haunted Woods and Abandoned Mine variants can bite, drain stats, and heal.

variantInfo.name: Vampyre Juvenile
notes: Can be damaged with any weapon but retreats as mist at low health unless held with Rod of ivandis or Ivandis flail special attack.
A normal juvenile kill does not give Slayer experience nor count for task progression unless Guthix balance kills it instantly or the resulting feral vampyre is killed.
Guthix balance outcomes can kill instantly, create a feral vampyre, or return the juvenile to human form.

variantInfo.name: Vampyre Juvinate
notes: Combat levels are 50, 54, 59, 75, 90, and 119; Slayer XP values are 60, 65, 85, 50, 110, 100, and 150 depending on version.
Mostly level 54 variants at task locations, awarding 65 Slayer experience per kill.
Can only be damaged with silver weaponry or Efaritay's aid, and may require Guthix balance handling when misting.

variantInfo.name: Vyrewatch
notes: Combat levels are 87, 105, 110, 120, and 125; Slayer XP values are 90, 90, 90, 105, and 110.
Finding a weapon capable of killing Vyrewatch requires beginning A Taste of Hope.
Can only be damaged with an Ivandis flail, Blisterwood flail, or Hallowed flail; Efaritay's aid gives accuracy but does not let normal weapons damage them.
The Slepe group north of Crombwick Manor is aggressive and attacks faster than the tithe-based Darkmeyer and Meiyerditch vyrewatch.

variantInfo.name: Vyrewatch Sentinel
notes: Requires completion of Sins of the Father to kill.
Can only be damaged with an Ivandis flail, Blisterwood flail, Hallowed flail, blisterwood sickle, or blisterwood stakes.
Only found in Darkmeyer and valued for the blood shard drop, nearby bank, and nearby altar.

variantInfo.name: Venator
notes: Normal Venator.

variantInfo.name: Blood-starved venator
notes: Superior spawn; cannot be selected as a repeatable farming target.

locationComparison.name: Burgh de Rott
notes: Contains 6 Feral Vampyres and 15 Vampyre Juvinates.
Requires completion of In Aid of the Myreque.

locationComparison.name: Darkmeyer
notes: Contains 6 Vampyre Juvinates, 8 Vyrewatch, and 19 Vyrewatch Sentinels.
Requires starting Sins of the Father.
Only location for highly profitable Vyrewatch Sentinels.
The area west of the Arboretum has a nearby altar, bank, and Drakan's medallion teleport.
Bank tellers require a disguise; the Hallowed Sepulchre lobby bank chest can be used instead.

locationComparison.name: God Wars Dungeon
notes: Contains 13 Feral Vampyres.
Feral Vampyres are Zamorak followers and are aggressive unless the player wears a Zamorak item.
Not recommended because the area is inconvenient and the spawns are spread out.

locationComparison.name: Haunted Woods
notes: Contains 19 Feral Vampyres.
Requires completion of Priest in Peril.
The fairy ring ALQ is in the middle of the Haunted Woods.
Nearby leeches can drain stats and do not appear on the minimap.

locationComparison.name: Meiyerditch
notes: Contains 4 Vampyre Juvinates and 61 Vyrewatch.
Requires starting Darkness of Hallowvale.

locationComparison.name: Slepe
notes: Contains 10 level 105 Vyrewatch north of Crombwick Manor.
Recommended after A Taste of Hope for Drakan's medallion access and nearby prayer restoration routing.

locationComparison.name: Wilderness God Wars Dungeon
notes: Contains 2 Feral Vampyres.
Requires either 60 Strength or 60 Agility.
Most of the dungeon is below level 30 Wilderness, so bring an emergency teleport.
Feral Vampyres are Zamorak followers and are aggressive unless the player wears a Zamorak item.

locationComparison.name: Apsul Hunting Ground
notes: More spawns are near the altar.

locationComparison.name: Virer Hunting Ground
notes: More spawns, but many are farther from the altar. One spawn cannot be reached with melee.

taskNotes: Before Actual Vampyre Slayer, Vampyre tasks are only assigned by Mazchna and Vannaka for 10-20 kills.
Actual Vampyre Slayer costs 80 Slayer reward points and allows Chaeldar, Konar, Nieve/Steve, and Duradel/Kuradal to assign Vampyres.
More at stake costs 100 Slayer reward points and extends Vampyre assignments to 200-250 kills.
Feral Vampyre variants are the easiest task option and can be killed with any weapon.
Vampyre Juveniles and Juvinates can mist at 25% or lower health unless held with Rod of ivandis or Ivandis flail special attack, then handled with Guthix balance.
Vyrewatch can only be damaged with an Ivandis flail, Blisterwood flail, or Hallowed flail.
Vyrewatch Sentinels are the best higher-tier target because they are near a bank and altar and can drop the blood shard.
Count Draynor counts toward a Vampyre task but does not grant Slayer experience; Vanstrom Klause does not count toward a Vampyre task.
Venators in Vampyrium count for Vampyre assignments after The Blood Moon Rises and require 74 Slayer and a designated vampyrebane weapon.
recommendedMethod: Use Feral Vampyres for the simplest task, Slepe Vyrewatch after A Taste of Hope, or Vyrewatch Sentinels in Darkmeyer after Sins of the Father for the profitable blood shard path.
